messages:
deploybot: Scheduling Dedicated rollout for AstraQuantum. Planned start: 2025-12-08 03:00 UTC. Traffic ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 20m observation windows. Model pinned: `rwinf-4.0.0-fp16`. Runtime image: `redwood/runtime:2025-11-30-c2`. KMS key: `projects/astra-quantum/keys/aq-key-7`. Release notes: https://rdw.co/releases/4.0.0. Rollback criteria: >0.4% 5xx over 5m OR p95 increased >30% vs baseline for 5m. Ticket: RD-4011.
emily: Quick question 1: can we start canary at 12% instead of 10%? customer wants slightly wider sampling to catch edge transcripts.
raj: 12% doable, but expect larger KV-cache priming. Suggest adding `--gradual-warmup=45s` to the canary slice to reduce cold spike.
ops_lead: Also: pin the grpc-proto layer to `v2.3.1` in the deployment config. If rollback is needed, previous runtime `redwood/runtime:2025-10-10-b7` must be kept warmed.
oncall: For observability, add ephemeral profiling for the first 10m of each canary step and capture top-kernel latencies. If p95 > 500ms for 2 consecutive minutes, pause rollout and escalate.
security: Heads up: aq-key-7 rotation scheduled 2025-12-08 05:00 UTC. That overlaps our post-rollout monitoring window. We need a documented exception or reschedule. @customer_pm can the customer shift rotation +8h?
customer_pm: Confirmed with infra team: they can move rotation to 2025-12-08 13:00 UTC. They want a note added to the runbook and a post-deploy confirmation message.
emily: I'll update the runbook and append a short audit note about the rotation exception.
deploybot: Updated plan: canary start 12% -> 30% -> 100%. Example start command:
```
rdw-deploy start --customer astra-quantum --model rwinf-4.0.0-fp16 --canary 12 --steps 30,100 --window 20m --runtime redwood/runtime:2025-11-30-c2 --warmup 45s
```
Live logs: https://rdw.co/logs/astra-quantum/1758003333
raj: Add explicit rollback commands to the runbook:
```
rdw-deploy rollback --customer astra-quantum --to rwinf-3.9.8
rdw-check state --customer astra-quantum --expect model=rwinf-3.9.8 --slices=all
rdw-cache flush --customer astra-quantum --kv-prefix="rwinf-4.0"
```
ops_lead: Agree with rollback steps. Also require healthgate: must see <0.25% 5xx for 15m before final 100% commit.
oncall: I'll be watching the dashboards; page if p95 > 650ms for 3m OR 5xx > 0.8% for 3m.
security: Exception logged: aq-key-7 rotation moved to 2025-12-08 13:00 UTC. Security will attach an audit entry to RD-4011.
emily: Final checks: runtime pinned, grpc pin noted, warmup added, rollback docs present, rotation delayed. Any objections to go at 03:00 UTC?
raj: No objections from infra.
ops_lead: Ops ready. Confirming backup runtime image available.
oncall: Oncall ready +30m pre-window.
customer_pm: PM will expect status pings at each canary boundary. I'll post updates to customer channel.
emily: Marking thread as approved. I'll add the checklist to RD-4011 and invite oncall to the runbook doc.
deploybot: Scheduled job will auto-start at 1758032400 (2025-12-08 03:00 UTC). This thread will receive deploybot updates during rollout. Good luck :rocket:
